designationHistory.indexText: President Coolidge proclaimed the Allegheny National Forest in Pennsylvania on lands bought under the Weeks Act.
designationHistory.note: FS-612 (2012) prints the citation as 42 Stat. 1925; the proclamation is in volume 43, as govinfo and Davis show.
